description_en: Modifies a ConnectorClient under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号下ConnectorClient
name: UpdateConnectorClient

parameters.help_en: The connector ID. You can call [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~) to query connector IDs
parameters.name: connector_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the ConnectorClient device. You can call [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~) to query connector information
parameters.help_zh: ConnectorClient设备唯一标识。取值来源：[ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~)批量查询Connector
parameters.name: dev_tag

parameters.help_en:
The connection status of the ConnectorClient. Valid values:
Enabled: connected.
Disabled: disconnected
parameters.help_zh:
ConnectorClient连接状态。取值：
Enabled：连接。
Disabled：断开
parameters.name: status
